items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: I went to Eastman and studied with Bonita Boyd there... when I was auditioning to get into Eastman James Galway had just accepted the offer to teach there... it was actually good that I didn't study with him

ctx.x: Do you think of yourself as a flautist or a flutist?
Well you know you get that question a lot. I think James Galway answered that question for everybody, you know you’re just a flutist and every once in a while you might flaut.
Okay, that’s good. It’s like the difference between a violin and a fiddle player.
